slides.texte_overlay:
6 hobbies that make you
surprisingly well rounded

1. cooking one dish
from every country

a world map on your plate.

2. birdwatching

you'll notice how alive
your own street is.

3. learning to dance

salsa, tango, ballet.
rhythm, posture, confidence.

4. sketching in museums

you look ten times longer
when you draw.

5. one documentary a week

space, oceans, empires.
one subject at a time.

6. a nightly lesson
instead of scrolling

5 minutes of art, history
or science before bed.
